{{Quote|Logray's instrument is indicating that Latara's inside...|Teebo|<ref name="TTL" />}}
'''Logray's instrument''' was a [[Magic/Legends|magic]] [[Flute/Legends|flute]] that belonged to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. It had the power to emit vibrations that could be picked up by another flute, allowing the flutists to locate each other. The Ewok warriors [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]] once used Logray's instrument to find their friend [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] when she went missing.<ref name="TTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Logray's instrument appeared in ''[[To Trap Latara]]'',<ref name="TTL" /> a [[Wikipedia:Spain|Spanish]] story of ambiguous [[canon]]icity that was published in [[1986]] under the ''[[MyComyc]]'' label.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/droids-and-ewoks-return-spains-lost-star-wars-comic-strips|text=Droids and Ewoks Return: Spain's Lost ''Star Wars'' Comic Strips|int=Droids and Ewoks Return: Spain's Lost Star Wars Comic Strips|nolive=1}}</ref>
